name: Sen no Hatou, Tsukisome no Kouki
original_name: 千の刃濤、桃花染の皇姫
source:
The ruins of the people's tranquility lie smoldering.

Two thousand years of prosperity have come to an end, the Empire conquered at the hands of degenerate invaders.
As what they once took for granted crumbles around them, its citizens nevertheless continue to strive for a better tomorrow, even as they are swept up in the tides of history.

Miyaguni Akari, the final heir to the imperial throne, seeks [i]power[/i]―for it is her absolute [i]duty[/i] to eradicate her sworn foes and reclaim her empire.
Tokita Soujin, a proud warrior without a past, seeks a [i]lord[/i]―for the noble blade must be wielded in the name of [i]fealty[/i].

Fate shall see to it that their paths will cross―and it is not the domain of man to know whether their journey shall end in despair or in triumph.

[Translated from the [url=https://august-soft.com/hatou/story.html]official website[/url]]
translation:
人民安宁的废墟仍在阴燃。

两千年的繁荣走到尽头，帝国被堕落的侵略者征服。
曾经习以为常的一切在身边崩塌，人民仍努力追求更好的明天，即使被卷入历史的潮流。

宫国明里是帝国皇位最后的继承人，追求[i]力量[/i]——因为消灭宿敌、夺回帝国是她绝对的[i]责任[/i]。
时田宗仁是一名没有过去、心怀骄傲的战士，追求一位[i]领主[/i]——因为高贵之刃必须以[i]忠诚[/i]之名挥舞。

命运会让他们相遇——至于旅程将以绝望还是胜利告终，并非人类所能知晓。
